name: HYPOTHETICAL (simulated user test; not a plan of any organisation): six storeys of second-stage transitional housing for youth 16 to 24, 34 small homes over ground-floor program space
notes: HYPOTHETICAL. Every figure here is MY ASSUMPTION as the simulated manager: the envelope (6 storeys, 19.8 m, 2,099 m2) is the tool's own suggestion for this C-2A lot; the program (30 studios and 4 one-bedrooms, all supportive, 24 at the shelter rate and 10 rent-geared-to-income, 300 m2 of program and staff space on the ground floor, no parking, 2 accessible homes) is the kind of scheme a youth transitional program would ask for; land $5,000,000, equity $2,000,000 and no other grants are round placeholders, not a valuation and not anyone's budget; no site control. The address is a real lot chosen only for its district and size.
